column1: # Known divergences of product rule 1 (D6773) the venue-oracles verb of ci/check_go.sh accepts as a skip: ticket,
# test, row (the subtest path after the test, as go test names it), reason. A skip passes only when its message is
# "KNOWN-DIVERGENCE <ticket> python=<answer> go=<answer>" (venueoracle.KnownDivergenceSkip) and this file holds
# its ticket, test and row. CI does not ask the tracker. Remove a row when its answers agree (the skip then fails).
